name: Medial Epicondyle Fracture in Children
definition: Avulsion-type fracture of the medial epicondyle in children/adolescents, often associated with elbow dislocation and valgus stress.

investigations.principle: Radiographs assess displacement and joint congruity.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Surgery is considered for incarcerated fragment, open injury, instability or selected displaced fractures.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Avulsion-type fracture of the medial epicondyle in children/adolescents, often associated with elbow dislocation and valgus stress.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
